subject: The 2-minute form hack you're missing
preview_text: Stop drowning in 20 minutes of racecards. This one feature cuts it to 120 seconds.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling when you open a racecard and see 12 horses, 6 form lines each, jockey stats, trainer stats, track conditions, and somehow you're supposed to pick a winner in 5 minutes? I used to spend 20 minutes per race doing that. Then I realized I was an idiot.

Here's the truth: your brain can't process 200 variables per horse. But Predictify's AI can. In 2 minutes flat, you get a confidence score that factors in jockey form, trainer performance, track conditions, and weather. What used to take me 20 minutes of squinting at tiny print now takes two taps. One guy told me he saved 3 hours on a single Saturday card.

Open the app, pick any race, and look at the 'Race Analysis' tab. You'll see a single number — the confidence score — that tells you exactly how the AI weighs the data. No more guessing. No more form-guide headaches. Just a sharp, data-backed pick in under 2 minutes.

Try it on the next race that catches your eye. See if you don't feel like the sharpest guy at the track. P.S. — Premium users get the full breakdown with speed ratings and handicap weights. The free version gives you the confidence score. Either way, you're saving 18 minutes per race.
